resources.string: Upload files to this phone from another device on the same Wi-Fi or Ethernet network.
Choose a local folder in internal storage or on an SD card.
Stopped. Tap Start to accept uploads.
Running. Open the address below on your other device.
Running, but no Wi-Fi or Ethernet IPv4 address is available. Connect both devices to the same local network.
An address appears while the server is running and connected to Wi-Fi or Ethernet.

Use only a trusted local network. HTTP does not encrypt uploads or the address. Anyone with this address can access the selected folder while the server runs. Stop the server when finished; each start creates a new private address.
Accepting local uploads. Tap to see the address.
The folder must allow persistent read and write access. Choose a local writable folder.
No installed file manager can open this folder. Open it from your Files app instead.
Allow access to the local network so other devices can upload to this phone. You can enable it in this app’s permissions.
Could not open the bundled license notices.
